006package dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter;
007
008import org.apache.commons.codec.BinaryDecoder;
009import org.apache.commons.codec.BinaryEncoder;
010import org.apache.commons.codec.binary.Base64;
011
012import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
013import java.util.List;
014
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IBase64BinaryItem;
017import dev.metaschema.core.qname.EQNameFactory;
018import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
019import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
020import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
021
022/**
023 * Maintains a byte buffer backed representation of a byte stream parsed from a
024 * BASE64 encoded string.
025 * <p>
026 * Provides support for the Metaschema <a href=
027 * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#BASE64">BASE64</a>
028 * data type.
029 */
030public class Base64Adapter
031    extends AbstractBinaryAdapter<IBase64BinaryItem> {
032  @NonNull
033  private static final List<IEnhancedQName> NAMES = ObjectUtils.notNull(
034      List.of(
035          EQNameFactory.instance().newQName(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH, "base64"),
036          // for backwards compatibility with original type name
037          EQNameFactory.instance().newQName(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH, "base64Binary")));
038
039  @NonNull
040  private static final Base64 BASE64 = ObjectUtils.notNull(Base64.builder().get());
041
042  Base64Adapter() {
043    super(IBase64BinaryItem.class, IBase64BinaryItem::cast);
044  }
045
046  @Override
047  protected BinaryEncoder getEncoder() {
048    return BASE64;
049  }
050
051  @Override
052  protected BinaryDecoder getDecoder() {
053    return BASE64;
054  }
055
056  @Override
057  public List<IEnhancedQName> getNames() {
058    return NAMES;
059  }
060
061  @Override
062  public IBase64BinaryItem newItem(Object value) {
063    ByteBuffer item = toValue(value);
064    return IBase64BinaryItem.valueOf(item);
065  }
066}
